title: Regulators, severity bands and the cause tree
guide: PCT, TAL/DCT and ADH as regulators; the four severity bands (printed in mg/dL); psychogenic polydipsia at 15-20 L/day; thiazide blocking the DCT; and the hypovolemic, hypervolemic and euvolemic arms with their urine sodium patterns.

title: Euvolemic typing, SIADH criteria and cerebral salt wasting
guide: Vomiting versus diarrhoea triangles, the rule-out step before SIADH, the five SIADH criteria, trauma/paraneoplastic/infection/drug/porphyria causes, and the CSW versus SIADH table with its uric acid and BNP entries.

title: Correction strategy: acute versus compensated chronic
guide: Under 48 hours as symptomatic with three 100 ml bottles of 3% saline over 10 minutes each; over 48 hours as compensated, with normal saline for hypovolaemia, 15-30 ml/hr 3% saline below 120, and fluid restriction plus vaptans above 120.
